import os, sys, time

    with open("/proc/%s/stat" % pid, "rb") as handle:

import base64, hashlib, hmac, ipaddress, socket, struct, sys, time
TYPES = {1: "A", 2: "NS", 5: "CNAME", 6: "SOA", 15: "MX", 16: "TXT", 28: "AAAA", 41: "OPT", 250: "TSIG", 255: "ANY"}
CLASSES = {1: "IN", 3: "CH", 254: "NONE", 255: "ANY"}
OPCODES = {0: "QUERY", 4: "NOTIFY", 5: "UPDATE"}
RCODES = {"NOERROR": 0, "SERVFAIL": 2, "NXDOMAIN": 3, "REFUSED": 5, "YXDOMAIN": 6, "NOTAUTH": 9}

opts = dict(a.split("=", 1) for a in sys.argv[4:])
rcodes = opts.get("rcodes", "NOERROR").split(",")
keyname, key = None, None
if "key" in opts:
    keyname, secretfile = opts["key"].split(":", 1)
    key = base64.b64decode(open(secretfile).read().strip())
wrong = opts.get("sign") == "wrong-key"
unsigned = opts.get("sign") == "none"
log = open(logpath, "w")
def out(line):
    log.write(line + "\n")
    log.flush()
def name(msg, off):
    labels, end = [], None
    for _ in range(128):
        n = msg[off]
        if n & 0xC0 == 0xC0:
            if end is None:
                end = off + 2
            off = ((n & 0x3F) << 8) | msg[off + 1]
            continue
        off += 1
        if n == 0:
            break
        labels.append(msg[off:off + n].decode("ascii", "replace"))
        off += n
    return (".".join(labels) + ".") if labels else ".", (end if end is not None else off)
def wire(text):
    data = b""
    for label in text.rstrip(".").split("."):
        if label:
            data += bytes([len(label)]) + label.lower().encode()
    return data + b"\0"
def parse(msg):
    ident, flags, qd, an, ns, ar = struct.unpack("!6H", msg[:12])
    off, questions = 12, []
    for _ in range(qd):
        owner, off = name(msg, off)
        t, c = struct.unpack("!HH", msg[off:off + 4])
        off += 4
        questions.append((owner, t, c))
    qend, sections = off, []
    for count in (an, ns, ar):
        records = []
        for _ in range(count):
            start = off
            owner, off = name(msg, off)
            t, c, ttl, rdlen = struct.unpack("!HHIH", msg[off:off + 10])
            off += 10
            records.append(dict(owner=owner, type=t, cls=c, ttl=ttl, rdoff=off, rdata=msg[off:off + rdlen], start=start))
            off += rdlen
        sections.append(records)
    return dict(id=ident, flags=flags, questions=questions, qend=qend, an=sections[0], ns=sections[1], ar=sections[2])
def rdata(msg, r):
    t, d = r["type"], r["rdata"]
    if not d:
        return "none"
    if t == 1 and len(d) == 4:
        return str(ipaddress.IPv4Address(d))
    if t == 28 and len(d) == 16:
        return str(ipaddress.IPv6Address(d))
    if t in (2, 5):
        return name(msg, r["rdoff"])[0]
    if t == 15:
        return "%d %s" % (struct.unpack("!H", d[:2])[0], name(msg, r["rdoff"] + 2)[0])
    if t == 6:
        _, o = name(msg, r["rdoff"])
        _, o = name(msg, o)
        return "serial=%d" % struct.unpack("!I", msg[o:o + 4])[0]
    return "hex=" + d.hex()

    ttl = "" if kind == "answer" else " ttl=%d" % r["ttl"]
    out("%s %s %s %s%s rdata=%s" % (kind, r["owner"], TYPES.get(r["type"], r["type"]),

    return (wire(kname) + struct.pack("!HI", 255, 0) + wire(alg) + signed.to_bytes(6, "big") +
            struct.pack("!HHH", fudge, error, len(other)) + other)
def verify(msg, p):
    records = [r for r in p["ar"] if r["type"] == 250]
    if not records:
        out("tsig=none")
        return None
    r = records[-1]
    alg, o = name(msg, r["rdoff"])
    signed = int.from_bytes(msg[o:o + 6], "big")
    fudge, size = struct.unpack("!HH", msg[o + 6:o + 10])
    mac = msg[o + 10:o + 10 + size]
    o += 10 + size
    origid, error, olen = struct.unpack("!HHH", msg[o:o + 6])
    other = msg[o + 6:o + 6 + olen]
    body = bytearray(msg[:r["start"]])
    struct.pack_into("!H", body, 0, origid)
    struct.pack_into("!H", body, 10, struct.unpack("!H", body[10:12])[0] - 1)
    valid = key is not None and r["owner"].lower() == keyname.lower().rstrip(".") + "." and alg.lower() == "hmac-sha256." and \
        hmac.compare_digest(hmac.new(key, bytes(body) + tsig_vars(r["owner"], alg, signed, fudge, error, other),
                                     hashlib.sha256).digest(), mac)
    out("tsig key=%s alg=%s mac=%s time=%s" % (r["owner"].lower(), alg.lower(), "valid" if valid else "invalid",
                                               "within-fudge" if abs(time.time() - signed) <= fudge else "outside-fudge"))
    return mac
def reply(msg, p, rcode, opcode, reqmac):
    flags = 0x8000 | (opcode << 11) | (0x0400 if opcode == 4 else 0) | RCODES[rcode]
    resp = struct.pack("!6H", p["id"], flags, len(p["questions"]), 0, 0, 0) + msg[12:p["qend"]]
    signed = "no"
    if reqmac is not None and key is not None and not unsigned:
        use = hashlib.sha256(key + b"wrong").digest() if wrong else key
        now, fudge = int(time.time()), 300
        mac = hmac.new(use, struct.pack("!H", len(reqmac)) + reqmac + resp +
                       tsig_vars(keyname, "hmac-sha256.", now, fudge, 0, b""), hashlib.sha256).digest()
        rd = wire("hmac-sha256.") + now.to_bytes(6, "big") + struct.pack("!HH", fudge, len(mac)) + mac + struct.pack("!HHH", p["id"], 0, 0)
        resp = bytearray(resp + wire(keyname) + struct.pack("!HHIH", 250, 255, 0, len(rd)) + rd)
        struct.pack_into("!H", resp, 10, 1)
        resp, signed = bytes(resp), ("wrong-key" if wrong else "yes")
    out("reply rcode=%s signed=%s" % (rcode, signed))
    return resp
def handle(msg, rcode):
    p = parse(msg)
    opcode = (p["flags"] >> 11) & 0xF
    out("message opcode=%s qr=%d aa=%d" % (OPCODES.get(opcode, opcode), p["flags"] >> 15, (p["flags"] >> 10) & 1))
    for owner, t, c in p["questions"]:
        out("%s %s %s %s" % ("zone" if opcode == 5 else "question", owner, TYPES.get(t, t), CLASSES.get(c, c)))
    if opcode == 5:
        for r in p["an"]:
            show("prereq", msg, r)
        for r in p["ns"]:
            show("update", msg, r)
    else:
        for r in p["an"]:
            show("answer", msg, r)
        if not p["an"]:
            out("answer=none")
    return reply(msg, p, rcode, opcode, verify(msg, p))
if mode == "update":
    server = socket.socket()
    server.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET, socket.SO_REUSEADDR, 1)
    server.bind(("127.0.0.1", port))
    server.listen(4)
    server.settimeout(8)
    for rcode in rcodes:
        try:
            conn, _ = server.accept()
        except socket.timeout:
            out("timeout waiting for message")
            break
        conn.settimeout(5)
        data = b""
        try:
            while len(data) < 2 or len(data) < 2 + struct.unpack("!H", data[:2])[0]:
                chunk = conn.recv(65536)
                if not chunk:
                    break
                data += chunk
            if len(data) >= 2:
                resp = handle(data[2:2 + struct.unpack("!H", data[:2])[0]], rcode)
                conn.sendall(struct.pack("!H", len(resp)) + resp)
        except (OSError, ValueError, IndexError, struct.error) as exc:
            out("error %s" % type(exc).__name__)
        conn.close()
else:
    server = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM)
    server.bind(("127.0.0.1", port))
    server.settimeout(8)
    for rcode in rcodes:
        try:
            msg, peer = server.recvfrom(65536)
        except socket.timeout:
            out("timeout waiting for message")
            break
        try:
            server.sendto(handle(msg, rcode), peer)
        except (OSError, ValueError, IndexError, struct.error) as exc:
            out("error %s" % type(exc).__name__)

import base64, hashlib, hmac, select, socket, struct, sys, time
port, logpath, ready, mode = int(sys.argv[1]), sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3], sys.argv[4]
signed_mode = mode.startswith("tsig-")
key = base64.b64decode(open(sys.argv[5]).read().strip()) if signed_mode else None
bad_index = {"tsig-single-bad": 0, "tsig-chain-bad": 1}.get(mode)
split = mode in ("axfr-multi", "tsig-chain", "tsig-chain-bad")
KEYNAME, ALG, FUDGE, APEX = "xfr-key.", "hmac-sha256.", 300, "sl.test."
TIMERS = (2, 2) if mode == "ixfr" else (3600, 600)
def wire(text):
    data = b""
    for label in text.rstrip(".").split("."):
        if label:
            data += bytes([len(label)]) + label.lower().encode()
    return data + b"\0"
def rr(owner, rtype, rdata):
    return wire(owner) + struct.pack("!HHIH", rtype, 1, 300, len(rdata)) + rdata
def a(label, addr):
    return rr(label + "." + APEX, 1, bytes(int(x) for x in addr.split(".")))
def soa(serial):
    return rr(APEX, 6, wire("ns1." + APEX) + wire("hostmaster." + APEX) +
              struct.pack("!5I", serial, TIMERS[0], TIMERS[1], 86400, 300))
NS, NS1, TXT = rr(APEX, 2, wire("ns1." + APEX)), a("ns1", "192.0.2.53"), rr("txt." + APEX, 16, b"\x0dslave fixture")
ZONE = {1: [NS, NS1, a("www", "192.0.2.10"), a("old", "192.0.2.66"), TXT],
        2: [NS, NS1, a("www", "192.0.2.11"), a("new", "192.0.2.99"), TXT]}
DELETED, ADDED = [a("old", "192.0.2.66"), a("www", "192.0.2.10")], [a("www", "192.0.2.11"), a("new", "192.0.2.99")]
state = {"serial": 1, "transfers": 0, "polls": 0}
log = open(logpath, "w")
def out(line):
    log.write(line + "\n")
    log.flush()
def name(msg, off):
    labels, end = [], None
    for _ in range(128):
        n = msg[off]
        if n & 0xC0 == 0xC0:
            if end is None:
                end = off + 2
            off = ((n & 0x3F) << 8) | msg[off + 1]
            continue
        off += 1
        if n == 0:
            break
        labels.append(msg[off:off + n].decode("ascii", "replace"))
        off += n
    return ".".join(labels).lower() + ".", (end if end is not None else off)
def tsig_vars(owner, alg, signed, fudge, error, other):
    return wire(owner) + struct.pack("!HI", 255, 0) + wire(alg) + signed.to_bytes(6, "big") + \
        struct.pack("!HHH", fudge, error, len(other)) + other
def parse(msg):
    ident, flags, qd, an, ns, ar = struct.unpack("!6H", msg[:12])
    if qd != 1:
        raise ValueError("qdcount")
    qname, off = name(msg, 12)
    qtype = struct.unpack("!H", msg[off:off + 2])[0]
    qend, records = off + 4, []
    off = qend
    for index in range(an + ns + ar):
        start = off
        owner, off = name(msg, off)
        rtype, _, _, rdlen = struct.unpack("!HHIH", msg[off:off + 10])
        records.append(dict(index=index, start=start, owner=owner, type=rtype, rdoff=off + 10))
        off += 10 + rdlen
    return dict(id=ident, qname=qname, qtype=qtype, qend=qend, an=an, ns=ns, ar=ar, records=records)
def request_tsig(msg, p):
    tsigs = [r for r in p["records"] if r["type"] == 250]
    if not tsigs:
        return "none", None
    r = tsigs[-1]
    if r["index"] != p["an"] + p["ns"] + p["ar"] - 1:
        return "invalid", None
    alg, o = name(msg, r["rdoff"])
    signed = int.from_bytes(msg[o:o + 6], "big")
    fudge, size = struct.unpack("!HH", msg[o + 6:o + 10])
    mac = msg[o + 10:o + 10 + size]
    o += 10 + size
    origid, error, olen = struct.unpack("!HHH", msg[o:o + 6])
    other = msg[o + 6:o + 6 + olen]
    body = bytearray(msg[:r["start"]])
    struct.pack_into("!H", body, 0, origid)
    struct.pack_into("!H", body, 10, p["ar"] - 1)
    valid = key is not None and r["owner"] == KEYNAME and alg == ALG and abs(time.time() - signed) <= fudge and \
        hmac.compare_digest(hmac.new(key, bytes(body) + tsig_vars(r["owner"], alg, signed, fudge, error, other),
                                     hashlib.sha256).digest(), mac)
    return ("valid" if valid else "invalid"), mac
def message(p, question, answers, rcode=0):
    return struct.pack("!6H", p["id"], 0x8400 | rcode, 1, len(answers), 0, 0) + question + b"".join(answers)
def sign(p, msgs, reqmac):
    now, prior, signed = int(time.time()), reqmac, []
    for n, m in enumerate(msgs):
        if n == 0:
            data = struct.pack("!H", len(prior)) + prior + m + tsig_vars(KEYNAME, ALG, now, FUDGE, 0, b"")
        else:
            data = struct.pack("!H", len(prior)) + prior + m + now.to_bytes(6, "big") + struct.pack("!H", FUDGE)
        mac = hmac.new(key, data, hashlib.sha256).digest()
        if n == bad_index:
            mac = bytes([mac[0] ^ 1]) + mac[1:]
        rd = wire(ALG) + now.to_bytes(6, "big") + struct.pack("!HH", FUDGE, len(mac)) + mac + struct.pack("!HHH", p["id"], 0, 0)
        sm = bytearray(m + wire(KEYNAME) + struct.pack("!HHIH", 250, 255, 0, len(rd)) + rd)
        struct.pack_into("!H", sm, 10, 1)
        signed.append(bytes(sm))
        prior = mac

def client_serial(msg, p):
    for r in p["records"]:
        if p["an"] <= r["index"] < p["an"] + p["ns"] and r["type"] == 6:
            _, o = name(msg, r["rdoff"])
            _, o = name(msg, o)
            return struct.unpack("!I", msg[o:o + 4])[0]
    return None
def full(serial):
    return [soa(serial)] + ZONE[serial] + [soa(serial)]
def respond(msg):
    p = parse(msg)
    question = msg[12:p["qend"]]
    status, reqmac = request_tsig(msg, p)
    tag = "query-tsig=%s" % status
    if signed_mode and status != "valid":
        out("qtype=%d %s refused=notauth" % (p["qtype"], tag))
        return [message(p, question, [], 9)]
    if p["qname"] != APEX or p["qtype"] not in (6, 251, 252):
        out("qtype=%d qname=%s %s refused" % (p["qtype"], p["qname"], tag))
        return [message(p, question, [], 5)]
    if p["qtype"] == 6:
        line = "soa reply-serial=%d" % state["serial"]
        msgs = [message(p, question, [soa(state["serial"])])]
        if state["transfers"]:
            state["polls"] += 1
            if mode == "ixfr" and state["polls"] == 1:
                state["serial"] = 2
    elif p["qtype"] == 252:
        line, records = "axfr", full(state["serial"])
        parts = [records[0:3], records[3:5], records[5:]] if split else [records]
        msgs = [message(p, question, part) for part in parts]
        state["transfers"] += 1
    else:
        have, now = client_serial(msg, p), state["serial"]
        line = "ixfr client-serial=%s" % have
        if have == 1 and now == 2:
            records = [soa(2), soa(1)] + DELETED + [soa(2)] + ADDED + [soa(2)]
        elif have == now:
            records = [soa(now)]
        else:
            records = full(now)
        msgs = [message(p, question, records)]
        state["transfers"] += 1
    sig = ""
    if signed_mode:
        msgs = sign(p, msgs, reqmac)
        sig = " signed=%s" % ("valid" if bad_index is None else "bad-mac-message-%d" % (bad_index + 1))
    out("%s %s messages=%d%s" % (line, tag, len(msgs), sig))
    return msgs
def readn(conn, n):
    data = b""
    while len(data) < n:
        chunk = conn.recv(n - len(data))
        if not chunk:
            return None
        data += chunk
    return data
udp = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM)
udp.bind(("127.0.0.1", port))
tcp = socket.socket()
tcp.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET, socket.SO_REUSEADDR, 1)
tcp.bind(("127.0.0.1", port))
tcp.listen(8)
open(ready, "w").close()
deadline = time.monotonic() + 40
while time.monotonic() < deadline:
    readable, _, _ = select.select([udp, tcp], [], [], 0.5)
    for sock in readable:
        if sock is udp:
            msg, peer = udp.recvfrom(65535)
            try:
                udp.sendto(respond(msg)[0], peer)
            except (OSError, ValueError, IndexError, struct.error) as exc:
                out("error %s" % type(exc).__name__)
            continue
        conn, _ = tcp.accept()
        conn.settimeout(3)
        try:
            while True:
                head = readn(conn, 2)
                body = head and readn(conn, struct.unpack("!H", head)[0])
                if not body:
                    break
                for m in respond(body):

import os, sys, time

def stat(pid):
    with open("/proc/%s/stat" % pid, "rb") as handle:
        data = handle.read()

        try:

            continue

            live.append(entry)

        break

    print("unsettled-processes=%d" % len(live))

CLASSES = {1: "IN", 3: "CH", 254: "NONE", 255: "ANY"}
OPCODES = {0: "QUERY", 4: "NOTIFY", 5: "UPDATE"}
RCODES = {"NOERROR": 0, "SERVFAIL": 2, "NXDOMAIN": 3, "REFUSED": 5, "YXDOMAIN": 6, "NOTAUTH": 9}

    keyname, secretfile = opts["key"].split(":", 1)
    key = base64.b64decode(open(secretfile).read().strip())

unsigned = opts.get("sign") == "none"
log = open(logpath, "w")
def out(line):
    log.write(line + "\n")
    log.flush()
def name(msg, off):
    labels, end = [], None
    for _ in range(128):
        n = msg[off]
        if n & 0xC0 == 0xC0:
            if end is None:
                end = off + 2
            off = ((n & 0x3F) << 8) | msg[off + 1]
            continue
        off += 1
        if n == 0:
            break
        labels.append(msg[off:off + n].decode("ascii", "replace"))
        off += n
    return (".".join(labels) + ".") if labels else ".", (end if end is not None else off)
def wire(text):
    data = b""
    for label in text.rstrip(".").split("."):
        if label:
            data += bytes([len(label)]) + label.lower().encode()
    return data + b"\0"
def parse(msg):
    ident, flags, qd, an, ns, ar = struct.unpack("!6H", msg[:12])
    off, questions = 12, []
    for _ in range(qd):
        owner, off = name(msg, off)
        t, c = struct.unpack("!HH", msg[off:off + 4])
        off += 4
        questions.append((owner, t, c))
    qend, sections = off, []
    for count in (an, ns, ar):
        records = []
        for _ in range(count):
            start = off
            owner, off = name(msg, off)
            t, c, ttl, rdlen = struct.unpack("!HHIH", msg[off:off + 10])
            off += 10
            records.append(dict(owner=owner, type=t, cls=c, ttl=ttl, rdoff=off, rdata=msg[off:off + rdlen], start=start))
            off += rdlen
        sections.append(records)
    return dict(id=ident, flags=flags, questions=questions, qend=qend, an=sections[0], ns=sections[1], ar=sections[2])
def rdata(msg, r):
    t, d = r["type"], r["rdata"]
    if not d:
        return "none"
    if t == 1 and len(d) == 4:
        return str(ipaddress.IPv4Address(d))
    if t == 28 and len(d) == 16:
        return str(ipaddress.IPv6Address(d))
    if t in (2, 5):
        return name(msg, r["rdoff"])[0]
    if t == 15:
        return "%d %s" % (struct.unpack("!H", d[:2])[0], name(msg, r["rdoff"] + 2)[0])
    if t == 6:
        _, o = name(msg, r["rdoff"])
        _, o = name(msg, o)
        return "serial=%d" % struct.unpack("!I", msg[o:o + 4])[0]
    return "hex=" + d.hex()

    ttl = "" if kind == "answer" else " ttl=%d" % r["ttl"]

    return (wire(kname) + struct.pack("!HI", 255, 0) + wire(alg) + signed.to_bytes(6, "big") +
            struct.pack("!HHH", fudge, error, len(other)) + other)

    records = [r for r in p["ar"] if r["type"] == 250]
    if not records:
        out("tsig=none")
        return None
    r = records[-1]
    alg, o = name(msg, r["rdoff"])
    signed = int.from_bytes(msg[o:o + 6], "big")
    fudge, size = struct.unpack("!HH", msg[o + 6:o + 10])
    mac = msg[o + 10:o + 10 + size]
    o += 10 + size
    origid, error, olen = struct.unpack("!HHH", msg[o:o + 6])
    other = msg[o + 6:o + 6 + olen]
    body = bytearray(msg[:r["start"]])
    struct.pack_into("!H", body, 0, origid)
    struct.pack_into("!H", body, 10, struct.unpack("!H", body[10:12])[0] - 1)

    signed = "no"

        use = hashlib.sha256(key + b"wrong").digest() if wrong else key

                       tsig_vars(keyname, "hmac-sha256.", now, fudge, 0, b""), hashlib.sha256).digest()
        rd = wire("hmac-sha256.") + now.to_bytes(6, "big") + struct.pack("!HH", fudge, len(mac)) + mac + struct.pack("!HHH", p["id"], 0, 0)
        resp = bytearray(resp + wire(keyname) + struct.pack("!HHIH", 250, 255, 0, len(rd)) + rd)
        struct.pack_into("!H", resp, 10, 1)
        resp, signed = bytes(resp), ("wrong-key" if wrong else "yes")
    out("reply rcode=%s signed=%s" % (rcode, signed))
    return resp
def handle(msg, rcode):
    p = parse(msg)
    opcode = (p["flags"] >> 11) & 0xF
    out("message opcode=%s qr=%d aa=%d" % (OPCODES.get(opcode, opcode), p["flags"] >> 15, (p["flags"] >> 10) & 1))
    for owner, t, c in p["questions"]:
        out("%s %s %s %s" % ("zone" if opcode == 5 else "question", owner, TYPES.get(t, t), CLASSES.get(c, c)))
    if opcode == 5:
        for r in p["an"]:
            show("prereq", msg, r)
        for r in p["ns"]:
            show("update", msg, r)
    else:
        for r in p["an"]:
            show("answer", msg, r)
        if not p["an"]:
            out("answer=none")
    return reply(msg, p, rcode, opcode, verify(msg, p))

        try:
            conn, _ = server.accept()
        except socket.timeout:

        data = b""

                chunk = conn.recv(65536)
                if not chunk:

                data += chunk
            if len(data) >= 2:
                resp = handle(data[2:2 + struct.unpack("!H", data[:2])[0]], rcode)
                conn.sendall(struct.pack("!H", len(resp)) + resp)
        except (OSError, ValueError, IndexError, struct.error) as exc:
            out("error %s" % type(exc).__name__)
        conn.close()
else:
    server = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM)
    server.bind(("127.0.0.1", port))
    server.settimeout(8)
    for rcode in rcodes:
        try:
            msg, peer = server.recvfrom(65536)
        except socket.timeout:
            out("timeout waiting for message")
            break
        try:
            server.sendto(handle(msg, rcode), peer)
        except (OSError, ValueError, IndexError, struct.error) as exc:
            out("error %s" % type(exc).__name__)

def request_tsig(msg, p):

        state["transfers"] += 1

        msgs = sign(p, msgs, reqmac)
        sig = " signed=%s" % ("valid" if bad_index is None else "bad-mac-message-%d" % (bad_index + 1))
